location_address: 1744 North Kimball Avenue Chicago, IL US 60647
description:
Studio W.I.P. invites you to unleash your creativity at our Glow Workshop — a blacklight-powered art experience like no other. Guided by our street art instructors, you’ll work with vibrant neon paints that come alive in the dark, transforming your canvas into a glowing masterpiece.

Whether you’re looking for a fun night out, a unique date idea, or a creative way to connect with friends, this workshop promises an unforgettable, high-energy atmosphere.

Create your own neon masterpiece on canvas (11” x 14”). 

Come ready to paint, play, and glow!

highlights:
Step into the dark and let your creativity shine. Our Neon Glow Workshop is an electrifying black light experience where street art meets ultraviolet color. Guests learn to paint, tag, and design using glowing pigments that come alive under UV light — turning every canvas into a radiant masterpiece.

💡 What to Expect:

Hands-on black light spray paint + stencil art

Luminous gear and creative freestyle zones

Live DJ and immersive lighting

Glow photo ops to capture your creation

It’s more than a workshop — it’s a full-spectrum vibe.
The darker it gets, the brighter you shine.
check_in_details: Check in with our artist at the front deck.
special_requirements: All children under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.
restrictions: Our workshop is not suggested for anyone who is visually impaired.
